title: Charaka Samhita
summary: The Charaka Samhita is the earliest extant Sanskrit medical manual, a foundation of Ayurveda, dated to the early to mid-second century CE and linked to Charaka, said to be a physician at the Kushan court of Kanishka. Its chapters note the text was compiled by Agnivesha, edited by Charaka and updated by Dridhabala.

uncertainty.note: Medical History review: early to mid-second century CE; Encyclopedia.com: Charaka flourished in the second century AD and served Kanishka (r. c. 78-103); nathas.org: some scholars date Charaka to the first century AD. Dridhabala's later edition is placed in the 8th-9th centuries by nathas.org.

as_recorded.value: dating from the early to mid-second century CE
